CButter Cookies · Put the steps in the correct order. Write 1–7.

a) Next, knead the dough with your hands until it is soft.

b) First, mix the soft butter and the sugar in a big bowl.

c) After that, bake them in the oven for fifteen minutes.

d) Then, crack the egg and add the vanilla.

e) Finally, let them cool and serve them with milk.

f) After that, add the flour and a pinch of salt.

g) Then, make small balls and put them on a baking tray.

Fruit Salad

First, the apples, the grapes and the strawberries. Then, the bananas, the oranges and the kiwis. After that, all the fruit into small pieces and put them in a big bowl. Next, half a lemon on the fruit. Then, two tablespoons of honey and everything carefully. Finally, some walnuts on top and serve it cold. It is sweet, juicy and healthy!

DLet’s Make Fruit Salad · Answer the questions.

First, wash the apples, the grapes and the strawberries. Then, peel the bananas, the oranges and the kiwis. After that, chop all the fruit into small pieces and put them in a big bowl. Next, squeeze half a lemon on the fruit. Then, add two tablespoons of honey and mix everything carefully. Finally, sprinkle some walnuts on top and serve it cold. It is sweet, juicy and healthy!

  2. 2
